macros.name: address
macros.doc: Creates a block containing authors previously specified.

macros.name: author
macros.doc: Separates groups of authors by their respective \address.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: Adds a footnote containing the email address of the previous author.

macros.name: eqref
macros.doc: The class defines the following four commands for referring to document elements: \figref, \tabref, \eqref, and \secref. They are used in a similar way to the \ref command, but print the name of the reference type before the numbered label.

macros.name: figref
macros.doc: The class defines the following four commands for referring to document elements: \figref, \tabref, \eqref, and \secref. They are used in a similar way to the \ref command, but print the name of the reference type before the numbered label.

macros.name: note
macros.doc: This command is used to typeset notes about the article at the footer of the opening page.

macros.name: num
macros.doc: The \unit and \num commands are defined for typesetting units and numbers with units, respectively. In the latter case, a thin space is used between the number and its unit, which is good typographical practise.

macros.name: secref
macros.doc: The class defines the following four commands for referring to document elements: \figref, \tabref, \eqref, and \secref. They are used in a similar way to the \ref command, but print the name of the reference type before the numbered label.

macros.name: showaffiliations
macros.doc: If the command \showaffiliations is placed before the author declarations, each author will reference the address to which they are associated.
